mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to anticipate reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units and retail sales below 450 billion dollars (450,000 million dollars) signals a broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100, it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector that increases stagflation risk and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll gain exceeding 150,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units and industrial production below 100 indicates a contraction in both consumer demand (housing) and industrial supply, triggering a broad economic slowdown that results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPI index above 240 signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and non-farm payrolls fall below 140,000 thousand persons, it indicates a weak labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 140000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) as a predictor of 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
